summary:
Comprehensive Architectural and Implementation Plan for Universal Skeleton Loading Alignment across all 16 categories in Atrium ERP & CRM:
1. Solves the missing 3-card skeleton issue on all list/grid collection views by replacing the entire page shell (Header + 3-KPI elevated pod tray + UniversalDataCollection table/grid) with a synchronous full-page skeleton wireframe.
2. Solves the dashboard layout mismatch by engineering 16 exact archetype structural skeletons in StructuralSkeletons.tsx that mirror each category's authentic layout (Dark Espresso pods, workstation grids, velocity histograms, triage queues, BTP progress, and milk/weighbridge desks).
3. Preserves instant cache-first SWR rendering during tab navigation while providing 100% pixel-perfect wireframes in Cold Start and Freeze Skeleton dev mode.
